title: Bag of Bricks-Lavender 10
descriptionHtml:
Lavender — colour 10

A muted, greyish purple that behaves more like a neutral than a colour. Lavender is invaluable for twilight skies and for the delicate shading between pale tones where a stronger purple would be too much.

Works well with: Lilac 06, Stone Blue 18, Cream 20

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Lavender bricks (colour 10) for Memobrick mosaics. A muted pastel purple for gradients, twilight skies and delicate shading work.
